summary: Rockstar Toronto's beat-'em-up adaptation of the 1979 film, later ported to PSP and re-released on PlayStation Network with music caveats.

entries.title: The Warriors

emulation.emulator: xemu or PCSX2/PPSSPP for other versions
emulation.notes: Use Xbox/xemu for the complete original route; PSN versions are convenience alternatives with music caveats.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox version with emulator scaling

primary.why: The Warriors released on PlayStation 2 and Xbox, then PSP, and later PS3/PS4 via PlayStation Network. The PS3/PS4 re-releases removed some licensed songs, so the original Xbox version is the best complete main route despite newer PlayStation convenience releases.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Xbox version on hardware or xemu; use PS4/PS3 only as convenience routes if the removed songs do not matter.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release with the original soundtrack context.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete original route because later PSN releases removed some licensed songs.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PS3/PS4 are convenient but have licensed-song removals; original Xbox keeps the soundtrack context and is the main route.
